name: Organisation Identification 2
definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

BIC.name: BIC
BIC.definition: Code allocated to a financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

IBEI.name: IBEI
IBEI.definition: International Business Entity Identifier to uniquely identify business entities playing a role in the lifecycle of and events related to a financial instrument. (tentative - to be confirmed).

BEI.name: BEI
BEI.definition: Code allocated to a non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

EANGLN.name: EANGLN
EANGLN.definition: Global Location Number. A non-significant reference number used to identify legal entities, functional entities, or physical entities according to the European Association for Numbering (EAN) numbering scheme rules.The number is used to retrieve detailed information that is linked to it.

CHIPSUniversalIdentification.name: CHIPS Universal Identification
CHIPSUniversalIdentification.definition: (United States) Clearing House Interbank Payments System (CHIPS) Universal Identification (UID) - identifies entities that own accounts at CHIPS participating financial institutions, through which CHIPS payments are effected. The CHIPS UID is assigned by the New York Clearing House.

DUNS.name: DUNS
DUNS.definition: Data Universal Numbering System. A unique identification number provided by Dun & Bradstreet to identify an organization.

BankPartyIdentification.name: Bank Party Identification
BankPartyIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous assignment made by a specific bank to identify a relationship as defined between the bank and its client.

TaxIdentificationNumber.name: Tax Identification Number
TaxIdentificationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution.
